question: Abomination, Terrifying Titan entered this turn and I activated his power-up ability for the reduced cost, putting a +1/+1 counter on him and having him fight a creature. I still have plenty of mana. Can I activate his power-up ability a second time this turn, paying the full cost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: a power-up ability can be activated only once, whether or not its cost was reduced.
expected.answer: 702.193a Power-up is a keyword that adds additional rules to the activated ability that follows it. “Power-up — [Cost]: [Effect]” means “[Cost]: [Effect]. If this permanent entered this turn, this ability’s cost is reduced by this permanent’s mana cost. Activate this ability only once.”

whyHard: Players read the cost reduction as the only thing power-up adds and treat the ability like any repeatable activated ability, but the keyword itself limits it to one activation ever, reduced cost or not.
